shellCommands.command: cat package.json 2>/dev/null | head -50 && echo "---" && ls -la
find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | sort

node -e "const r = require('/workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js'); console.log(Object.keys(r).filter(k => /Transition|View/i.test(k)))" 2>&1
echo "---"
cat /workspace/node_modules/react/package.json | grep version
echo "---"
cat /workspace/node_modules/next/package.json | grep version
echo "---"
grep -r "unstable_ViewTransition\|ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | head -20
echo "---next---"
grep -rl "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rn "viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "---"
grep -rln "viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v compiled | head -30

grep -rn "transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/app-router-context.shared-runtime.js 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "---types---"
grep -rn "transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null
echo "---react ViewTransition export in experimental---"
grep -n "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-experimental/cjs/react.development.js | head -5
echo "---check app router uses react-experimental---"
grep -rn "react-experimental" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/require.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/build/webpack-config.js 2>/dev/null | head -10

find /workspace/node_modules/@types/react -iname "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -ln "ViewTransition" 2>/dev/null
echo "---"
find /workspace/node_modules/next -path "*react-experimental*" -iname "*.d.ts" 2>/dev/null | head
echo "---check react.d.ts in @types/react---"
grep -n "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30

cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
echo "---"
grep -n "canary\|experimental" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/package.json
echo "---index.d.ts includes?---"
grep -n "canary\|experimental\|reference" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20
echo "---next global types---"
find /workspace -maxdepth 1 -iname "*.d.ts"
cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null

grep -rn "react/canary\|react/experimental" /workspace/node_modules/next/*.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "---search whole next pkg for types referencing canary---"
grep -rln "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null
find /workspace/node_modules/next -maxdepth 1 -iname "*.d.ts"
echo "---next-env exists?---"
ls -la /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>&1
echo "---check next types/global---"
find /workspace/node_modules/next/types -iname "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -l "canary" 2>/dev/null
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60

grep -n "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts
echo "---package types field---"
grep -n '"types"\|"exports"' -A3 /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/package.json | head -20
npx tsc --version

npx tsc --noEmit --listFiles 2>&1 | grep -i "app/page.tsx\|ProductGrid.tsx\|slug.*page.tsx"
echo "exit: $?"
echo "---try explicit error check---"
npx tsc --noEmit app/page.tsx 2>&1 | head -30
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "EXIT: $?"

npx tsc --noEmit --pretty false 2>&1 | tee /tmp/tsc_full.log | wc -l
cat /tmp/tsc_full.log

ls -la /workspace/.next 2>&1 | head
echo "---"
find /workspace -maxdepth 1 -name "*.d.ts"
echo "---moduleResolution bundler behavior: check with explicit tsconfig via project flag---"
npx tsc --noEmit -p /workspace/tsconfig.json --listFiles 2>&1 | grep -i "react/index.d.ts\|canary.d.ts\|experimental.d.ts"

grep -rln "reference.*canary\|reference.*experimental" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react-dom/*.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts /workspace/node_modules/next/**/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null
echo "---check react-dom canary references react canary?---"
head -20 /workspace/node_modules/@types/react-dom/canary.d.ts
echo "---why would tsc pick up canary.d.ts without explicit reference? check @types auto typeRoots---"
grep -n "typeRoots\|types" /workspace/tsconfig.json
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -60
git diff --stat; git status --short

cat /workspace/.gitignore
echo "---tsconfig diff---"
git diff tsconfig.json
echo "---package.json diff (pre-existing before my changes)---"
git diff package.json

echo ".next/
tsconfig.tsbuildinfo" >> .gitignore
cat .gitignore

d=/workspace; while :; do
  grep -Hm1 '^description:' "$d"/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null
  [ -e "$d/.git" ] || [ "$d" = / ] && break
  d=$(dirname "$d")
done

which chromium-cli; lsof -ti:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill; nohup npm run dev > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 & disown
timeout 30 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done' && echo "SERVER UP" || (echo "FAILED"; cat /tmp/next-dev.log)

find / -iname "chromium-cli*" -not -path "*/node_modules/.cache/*" 2>/dev/null | head -5
echo "---npx playwright?---"
npx --no-install playwright --version 2>&1
echo "---global node modules with playwright---"
npm ls -g --depth=0 2>&1 | grep -i play
find / -iname "*playwright*" -maxdepth 6 -type d 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules/.cache | head -20
cd /tmp && npm init -y --silent >/dev/null 2>&1; timeout 60 npm install playwright-core@1.62.1 2>&1 | tail -20

which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable 2>&1
find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "*chromium*" -o -iname "*chrome*" 2>/dev/null | grep -vi node_modules | grep -v "\.cache/ms-playwright" | head -20
ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>&1
cd /tmp && timeout 90 npx playwright-core install chromium 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /tmp && node vt-check.mjs 2>&1
which apt-get sudo 2>&1; id

find / -iname "libnspr4.so*" 2>/dev/null
which dnf yum apk 2>&1
cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null
sudo -n true 2>&1 && echo "PASSWORDLESS SUDO OK" || echo "NO PASSWORDLESS SUDO"
sudo dnf install -y nss nspr atk at-spi2-atk cups-libs libdrm libxkbcommon libXcomposite libXdamage libXfixes libXrandr mesa-libgbm alsa-lib pango cairo 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /tmp && node vt-check.mjs 2>&1

mkdir -p /tmp/videos && cd /tmp && node vt-video.mjs 2>&1
ls -la /tmp/videos

FFMPEG=$(find ~/.cache/ms-playwright -iname "ffmpeg*" -type f | head -1)
echo "ffmpeg: $FFMPEG"
mkdir -p /tmp/frames
"$FFMPEG" -i /tmp/videos/*.webm -vf fps=10 /tmp/frames/f-%03d.png -y 2>&1 | tail -20
ls /tmp/frames | wc -l

FFMPEG=$(find ~/.cache/ms-playwright -iname "ffmpeg*" -type f | head -1)
VID=$(ls /tmp/videos/*.webm)
mkdir -p /tmp/frames
"$FFMPEG" -i "$VID" -vf "fps=10" /tmp/frames/f-%03d.png -y 2>&1 | tail -10
ls /tmp/frames | wc -l

FFMPEG=$(find ~/.cache/ms-playwright -iname "ffmpeg*" -type f | head -1)
VID=$(ls /tmp/videos/*.webm)
"$FFMPEG" -i "$VID" -r 10 /tmp/frames/f-%03d.png -y 2>&1 | tail -10
ls /tmp/frames | wc -l
ls /tmp/frames
cd /tmp && node vt-reduced-motion.mjs 2>&1

pid=$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ':3000' | grep -oP 'pid=\K[0-9]+' | head -1)
if [ -z "$pid" ]; then pid=$(fuser 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null); fi
echo "pid: $pid"
[ -n "$pid" ] && kill $pid 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"
rm -rf /tmp/vt-check.mjs /tmp/vt-video.mjs /tmp/vt-reduced-motion.mjs /tmp/videos /tmp/frames /tmp/*.png /tmp/next-dev.log
ps aux | grep -i "next\|node" | grep -v grep

kill 1254 1266 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"
rm -rf /tmp/*.png /tmp/next-dev.log
ps aux | grep -i "next dev\|next-server" | grep -v grep
git diff -- app/ProductGrid.tsx app/page.tsx "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx" app/globals.css
